items.name: utils
items.description: The cn() class-name helper every component uses.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: The whole token layer as one stylesheet: colors, radius, spacing, type, shadows, cursors, light and dark.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: The kit icon set (Google Material Symbols, Apache 2.0), named by purpose so it can be swapped in one place.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Scopes an appearance and token overrides to a subtree.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button in semantic variants, appearances and sizes; renders a link with href, and any element with render.

items.name: input-field
items.title: Input field
items.description: Internal: the label (with an optional info note), helper text, validation and field box shared by Field, Text Input, Textarea, Search, Number Input, Select and Combobox.

items.name: text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: Single-line text field with label, helper text, validation, prefix and suffix, add-ons and buttons inside the field, on Base UI Field.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, required mark, info note and helper text with validation for a control that has none of its own, on Base UI Field.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Horizontal or vertical separator line, solid or dashed, in several thicknesses.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Count or dot that flags something new, inline or floating on another element.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Key cap that shows which key to press, alone or as a combination.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round picture of a person with initials and silhouette fallbacks, neutral or any accent hue in subtle or solid.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Short status or category label, status and hue variants and appearances, with an optional remove button.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: Button that stays pressed, on Base UI Toggle; neutral when off, the variant when on.

items.name: choice-field
items.title: Choice field
items.description: Internal: the label, helper text and validation wiring shared by Checkbox, Radio and Switch.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch with label and helper text, on Base UI Switch and Field.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with label, helper text and indeterminate state, on Base UI Checkbox and Field.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio group from a flat options list, with legend and helper text, on Base UI Radio Group, Field and Fieldset.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Headings that show and hide sections, from a flat items list, on Base UI Accordion.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface for related content: elevated, outline, filled or unstyled; a button with onClick or a link with render.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field with auto-size, rows and resize, on the shared input field.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: Search field with icon and clear button; Escape clears in every browser, and an optional key such as / focuses it.

items.name: resend-button
items.title: Resend button
items.description: Internal: the small Resend code / Resend link button shared by OTP Input and the auth templates, disabled with a countdown while it cools down; a failed send starts no cooldown.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time code entry, one cell per character, with optional grouping and a resend button with cooldown, on Base UI OTP Field.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with a Show / Hide button named after its label, hidden again when the form is sent, and optional rules for a new password, ticked off as the reader types; on Text Input.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Number field with stepper buttons, limits and precision, on Base UI Number Field.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One option from a list that opens below the field, on Base UI Select.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to filter a list and choose one option, with match highlighting, on Base UI Combobox.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator: a status, or a progress ring with a value; delay keeps fast loads from flashing it.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Linear progress on Base UI Progress: determinate or indeterminate, with an optional label and value.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Decorative placeholder in the shape of loading content: circle, square or rounded, with rows.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline or standalone link with colour, size, underline, external and disabled states; render prop for router links.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Page or section message in info, success, warning or danger, subtle/outlined/solid, with optional title, action, close button and live announcement.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What an empty list, table or page shows: icon, title as a real heading, description and next action, at a compact or roomy size.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short inverted label on hover or focus, with side and delay, on Base UI Tooltip; TooltipGroup shares the delay.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored dialog panel with title, description and close button, modal or not, on Base UI Popover.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Centred dialog with title, description, scrolling body and footer, or an alert dialog for decisions, on Base UI Dialog and Alert Dialog.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Panel that slides in from the right, left or bottom edge over a scrim, with title, description, scrolling body and pinned footer, and swipe to dismiss, on Base UI Drawer.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Alert dialog that asks before a destructive action: warning icon, the action as a question, its consequence, Cancel with focus, a destructive button, and optional type-to-confirm, on Modal.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Dialog that finds a command or a record by typing and runs it with Enter, in groups, with shortcuts as key caps and a ⌘K hotkey, on Base UI Autocomplete and Dialog.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown of actions, links, checkbox and radio items, groups and submenus from an items array, on Base UI Menu.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Menu opened at the pointer by a right click or long press on an area, a row, a card or an object, with the same entries as Menu, on Base UI Context Menu.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Row of menus as in a desktop app, File, Edit, View, each opening a Menu flyout, with arrow-key movement along the bar, on Base UI Menubar.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Navigation trail with the current page marked, collapsible middle and router-friendly links.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous, next and a stable range of page numbers with ellipses, as buttons or links, with an optional rows summary and rows-per-page select.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Underline or pill tabs with a sliding indicator, icons, vertical orientation and panels, on Base UI Tabs.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Corner notifications with variants, action, timeout, promise and swipe to dismiss: ToastProvider plus useToast(), on Base UI Toast.

items.name: inline-alert
items.title: Inline Alert
items.description: One-line message in the flow of a form or section: icon, text in the variant's colour, optional action and live announcement.

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error State
items.description: What a list, panel or page shows when loading failed: Empty State in the danger tone, with details and a live announcement.

items.name: success-state
items.title: Success State
items.description: What a finished flow shows: Empty State in the success tone, with the next step as its action.

items.name: collapse
items.title: Collapse
items.description: One show/hide section with a text-button trigger, changing label and find-in-page support, on Base UI Collapsible.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single-value or range slider with label, formatted value, per-thumb names and vertical orientation, on Base UI Slider.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through ordered steps, horizontal or vertical, with complete/current/upcoming/error states and optional back navigation.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star rating on native radios, interactive or read-only with fractional stars, sizes and custom value text.

items.name: column-chooser
items.title: Column Chooser
items.description: Button that opens a popover listing a table's columns, each with a checkbox to show or hide it, the row header locked, and a Reset to the default set.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Native table with captions, row headers, sortable columns (aria-sort), row selection, expandable rows, a row actions menu, a total row, resizable columns, density, sticky header and an empty state.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Line, area, bar (stacked or grouped) and pie or donut charts in SVG, plus Sparkline and ChartLegend. Coloured by the --chart tokens, with a crosshair tooltip, legend toggles and a table view.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid with full keyboard support, min/max and disabled days, today and locale-aware weeks, on Intl with no date library.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date and date range fields that take typed dates in the locale's order and open a Calendar in a popover, with optional range presets; submit ISO dates.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides in a native scroll-snap track, with previous/next, dots, loop and pausable autoplay.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A hex field with a Figma-style popover picker: saturation/brightness area, hue and opacity strips, Hex/RGB/HSL/HSB fields and swatches. Also exports ColorPanel.

items.name: file-uploader
items.title: File Uploader
items.description: Drop zone and Choose button over a native file input, with type/size/count checks, a file list, and per-file progress or errors.

items.name: saved-views
items.title: Saved Views
items.description: Application UI pattern: predefined and saved views of a list or table as tabs or a menu, with a modified mark, Save, Save as new view and Manage views.

items.name: table-chart
items.title: Table Chart Switch
items.description: Application UI pattern: one set of records as a table or a chart, switched with tabs, under the same filters.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: Application UI pattern: a value in a table cell or description list row that edits in place, with Enter/Escape, Save/Cancel, an error at the field and a saving state.

items.name: session
items.title: Session
items.description: Application UI pattern: the two ends of a session. SessionTimeout warns before an idle session ends, with a countdown, Stay signed in and Sign out in an alert dialog; SignedOut is the page after it ends, in the Auth Layout, with the reason, the remembered account and Sign in again.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Application UI pattern: search and per-field filter controls above a list or table, the applied filters as removable chips, and Clear all.

items.name: card-heading
items.title: Card Heading
items.description: Application UI pattern: the top row of a card, with title, optional description, avatar or icon, and actions.

items.name: stats
items.title: Stats
items.description: Application UI pattern: key figures in cards, with optional change since last period, icon and link.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Application UI pattern: a record's fields as terms and details, in columns, a two-column grid or stacked, optionally on a card.

items.name: form-layouts
items.title: Form Layouts
items.description: Application UI pattern: FormSection (split or stacked, one or two columns, optionally on a card), FormFieldGroup (a fieldset of related fields with a legend), FormFullWidth and FormActions.

items.name: data-table-page
items.title: Data Table Page
items.description: Application UI pattern: TableToolbar (search, filters, actions; bulk actions while rows are selected) and TableFooter (a Pagination with its rows summary and rows-per-page select) around a Table.

items.name: nav-sidebar
items.title: Nav Sidebar
items.description: Application UI pattern: the app's side navigation, as in the Claude apps: a logo row with the collapse button, a header for the tenant switcher and search, links in categories that open, close, show more and take an add action, badges, the current page, a footer for notifications, help and the account, NavSidebarButton rows (ghost, switcher, field) for those, and a collapsible icon rail with tooltips that previews the full sidebar on hover. One of the pieces an App Shell places.

items.name: vertical-nav
items.title: Vertical Nav
items.description: Application UI pattern: secondary navigation inside a page, e.g. the sections of Settings: links with optional icons and counts, optional named groups, and the current section.

items.name: action-panel
items.title: Action Panel
items.description: Application UI pattern: a card offering one action, with a title, a description and a button, switch or small form below or beside the text, and a danger variant for what cannot be undone.

items.name: feed
items.title: Feed
items.description: Application UI pattern: a feed or timeline of events, each a sentence of who did what and when, with an avatar or icon, an optional comment under it, an optional link and unread dot, a connecting line, an empty state and an optional comment box.

items.name: list-container
items.title: List Container
items.description: Application UI pattern: the frame around a list, with a line between rows, flat, in a card or as separate cards, and a footer and an empty state.

items.name: stacked-list
items.title: Stacked List
items.description: Application UI pattern: a list of records as rows, each with an avatar or icon, a title and a line under it, a status, facts at the end, and a link to the record or a menu of actions that also opens on right click, in a List Container: flat, card or separate, with a footer and an empty state.

items.name: grid-list
items.title: Grid List
items.description: Application UI pattern: records as cards in a responsive grid, each with an optional cover picture, an avatar or icon, a title, a status, a line and facts under it, and a link to the record or a menu of actions that also opens on right click; the same item as Stacked List, framed by List Container with a footer and an empty state.

items.name: media-object
items.title: Media Object
items.description: Application UI pattern: an avatar, icon or image beside a title and description, aligned to the top, middle, bottom or stretched, on either side, with room for actions or nested replies; the text wraps under the media in a narrow container.

items.name: import-export
items.title: Import Export
items.description: Application UI pattern: ImportDialog brings a CSV (or Excel, with your own reader) into a list in three steps in a Modal: upload with the File Uploader, map each column to a field, review every row with its problems beside it and import the rows without any, ending on the result with the skipped rows to download. ExportDialog takes rows out: which rows, which columns (Column Chooser) and, when there is a choice, which format. Ships parseCsv, toCsv (formula-safe) and downloadCsv.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: Application UI pattern: NotificationCenter, a bell for the Top Bar with the unread count that opens a panel of notifications in a Popover, and NotificationPanel, the inside on its own: a heading with Mark all as read and your actions, optional All and Unread tabs, rows as Feed sentences that link and carry an unread dot, and an empty state.

items.name: top-bar
items.title: Top Bar
items.description: Application UI pattern: TopBar, the bar above the page (start, middle and end slots, the shell's brand), and TopBarNav links across it, which scroll sideways when they do not fit.

items.name: app-content
items.title: App Content
items.description: Application UI pattern: AppContent, the page region of an App Shell, flat on one card surface or as blocks on the canvas, following the Theme's contentStyle, with an optional aside column beside the page.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell (template)
items.description: Template: AppShell, the frame of an application. It places the TopBar, NavSidebar and AppContent patterns on the Theme's canvas (full-height sidebar or full-width top bar, solid or transparent pieces, a brand slot, flat or card content, an optional aside column right of the page), with a skip link; below 64rem the sidebar is the icon rail, below 80rem the aside goes under the page.

items.name: settings-template
items.title: Settings (template)
items.description: Settings page template inside an App Shell: a Vertical Nav of sections beside the one shown (above it on a narrow page), each section a form of Form Sections with a sticky save bar (Discard, Save, a status line), change password with Password Input, and a Delete account danger zone confirmed in an alert dialog, on sample data.

items.name: home-template
items.title: Home (template)
items.description: Home page (dashboard, overview) template inside an App Shell: a greeting with a period select, a setup guide in an Action Panel until every step is done, key figures with trends, a chart card and a task list in Card Headings, and recent activity across projects in the aside, on sample data.

items.name: projects-template
items.title: Projects (template)
items.description: Index page (list report) template: projects inside an App Shell, in saved views with counts, narrowed by search and filters with chips, as a paged table or a chart, with sorting, a column chooser, bulk archive and an expandable activity per row, on sample data.

items.name: project-detail-template
items.title: Project Detail (template)
items.description: Object page template: one project inside an App Shell, with a breadcrumb, a header (name, status, key facts, actions), Overview and Team tabs, an aside with the summary and activity, and an Edit drawer whose changes join the activity, on sample data.

items.name: auth-layout
items.title: Auth Layout (template)
items.description: Template: AuthLayout, the frame every auth screen shares. The logo, the title and the form in one narrow column on the Theme's canvas, in a card or plain, or beside a panel from 64rem; with AuthProviders (single sign-on buttons and the "or" line, AuthDivider).

items.name: sign-in-template
items.title: Sign In (template)
items.description: Sign-in page template inside the Auth Layout: optional single sign-on buttons and an "or" line, email and password with Show / Hide, Keep me signed in, Forgot password and Sign up links; it checks the fields, then hands valid values to onSignIn and shows the message it returns.

items.name: sign-up-template
items.title: Sign Up (template)
items.description: Sign-up page template inside the Auth Layout: optional single sign-on buttons and an "or" line, full name, email and a new password with its rules ticked off as the reader types, an optional terms checkbox, and a Sign in link; it checks the fields, then hands valid values to onSignUp and shows the message it returns.

items.name: forgot-password-template
items.title: Forgot Password (template)
items.description: Forgot- and reset-password page templates inside the Auth Layout. ForgotPassword: the email, then "Check your email" without saying whether an account exists, with Resend link after a cooldown and Use a different email. ResetPassword, the page the link opens: a new password with its rules ticked off as the reader types, then "Password changed" and Sign in. Each hands valid values to its handler and shows the message it returns.

items.name: progressive-sign-in-template
items.title: Progressive Sign In (template)
items.description: Email-first sign-in page template inside the Auth Layout: the email with Remember my email and Continue; onContinue routes the account to a password step (the email with Change, the password, Forgot password) or to its single sign-on provider, with a spinner while the redirect loads. It checks the fields and shows the message each handler returns.

items.name: mfa-challenge-template
items.title: MFA Challenge (template)
items.description: Two-step verification page template inside the Auth Layout: a one-time code from an authenticator app, a text message or an email (with Resend code), Remember this device, Try another way to switch method, and Use a backup code. It checks the code is complete and shows the message each handler returns.
